title: demo_cta_button near-duplicates cta_button in landing.gleam (only href and palette differ)
detail: AGENTS.md: extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places. Two functions with identical shape differing only in href and colour classes; the demo nav links already reuse the shared nav_link/mobile_menu_link helpers, so this one duplication is inconsistent with the file's own pattern.
recommended_fix: Collapse into one cta_button taking href and a variant (or class override) parameter; keep the two call sites' testids and labels unchanged.
